title: MZ Anyone have a blank using-Axe/tools directional sprite base?

posts.author: CreatureCola
posts.body:
I'm setting up player animations for using different tools, I was just wondering if anyone happened to already have the blank base made for using an axe in the usual walking/direction sprite sheet? for free/commercial use. ( willing to pay if need be, I always feel bad for asking lol )
Ones using a Sycle or other tools could be useful as well :0
( I've got a Reid model to reference for making fishing rod, Watering can and Hoe animations but haven't fully put them together with my actual sprite yet. anything else could be helpful! ) if not thanks anyway!
